product_metadata.title: Sagler Stackable Pantry Can Organizer - 3-Tier Soda Can Organizer - Multifunctional Chrome-Finish Can Rack Organizer for Up to 36 Cans - For Pantry, Kitchen Cabinet, Countertop, Under Sink - 17x13x13
features: Organize Your Kitchen - Sort canned sodas, veggies, fruits, and soups. Our 3-tier can organizer for pantry includes adjustable connectors and intervals, allowing you to store up to 36 differently-sized cans.
Easy Access - With an adjustable tilted design, this canned food storage rack lets the next cans roll forward when you pick up a can from the front. The canned goods also remain conveniently visible.

Built to Last - This can rack organizer is made with heavy-duty gauge steel and has non-slip foot pads. This pantry can storage dispenser flaunts an elegant chrome finish that looks great in any space.
Space-Saving Storage for Cans - The stackable 17"Wx13"Hx13"D can storage rack fits on most shelves, countertops, or cabinets. You can stack another set of racks on top to double its capacity.

Effortless Assembly - You can set up the pantry can holder without any screws or tools. And if it needs cleaning, just wipe it with a damp cloth. You can also use mild detergent to remove tough stains.
